senses.gloss:
m. (-त्नुः)
Breath, life.
E.
गम to go, to depart, इत्नुच् Uṇādi affix, and the radical repeated.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Wishing or endeavouring to go.
E.
गम to go, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

f. (-षा)
Wish to go or move.
E.
गम to go, desider. form अङ्, and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to go.
E.
गम to go, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to take, to lay hold of, to take away.
E.
गृ to seize, desiderative form, उ aff.

f. (-षा)
1 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome.
2 Eminence.
3 Usage, profession or habit of life.
E.
जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Striving to overcome, vieing or contending with.
E.
जि to conquer; desiderative form, affix उ.
